description: Evolvra trace logger: appends every tool call and subagent completion to ~/.evolvra/traces.jsonl so the core can score and evolve agents later. Stdlib only, never blocks.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/log_event.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/log_event.py"; fi
